sources.title: Renovel — Dubai renovation component benchmarks
sources.note: Published porcelain installation AED 150–300/m² and natural stone AED 350–700/m². Used to check material bands, not to multiply the full 207 m² built-up area.

sources.title: Liger Interiors — room and finish cost guide
sources.note: Published standard bathrooms AED 25,000–35,000 and ordinary 3-bedroom interior painting AED 8,000–15,000. Our room amounts vary for scope, retained fittings and selected finish allowances.

sources.title: Dream Floor Landscaping — 2026 supplied-and-installed rates
sources.note: Published outdoor porcelain AED 180–350/m², natural stone AED 300–800/m², pergolas AED 8,000–25,000 and artificial turf AED 60–150/m². Small fixed-cost items are separately allowed here.

sources.title: IKEA UAE — outdoor dining retail reference
sources.note: A table with six chairs was listed at AED 2,995 when checked. This is a lower retail reference, not the products shown; design allowances are higher for finish, delivery and selection.

sources.title: Smart Cities — small pool and equipment guide
sources.note: Published 3 × 2 m plunge pools AED 60,000–90,000; heating/chilling AED 15,000–40,000. Model separates decking, equipment, fees and contingency. Published pool service AED 5,000–12,000/year excludes extra temperature-control utility use.

sources.title: Expert Pools — contrasting small-pool benchmark
sources.note: Advertised compact plunge pool range AED 25,000–45,000 with exclusions. Contractor guides differ substantially; the model uses the higher pool band for this un-surveyed site rather than treating the lowest advertised figure as a quote.

sources.title: Federal Tax Authority — standard VAT rate
sources.note: The standard UAE VAT rate is 5%. The report applies a conservative 5% budget allowance to the subtotal plus contingency; actual fee and invoice tax treatment may differ.
